subject.title: fix(gateway): keep plugin approval title and description truncation UTF-16 safe

question: Should maintainers preserve this broad branch as an intentional multi-surface PR, or require it to be narrowed back to the gateway UTF-16 approval fix before merge?
rationale: The central bug fix is now correct, but the live PR includes hundreds of unrelated changes and a maintainer is assigned, so automation should not close or discard the branch without human intent.

options.title: Narrow to gateway fix
options.body: Keep only `src/gateway/node-invoke-plugin-policy.ts` and its test changes, then rerun focused gateway validation on the exact head.

options.title: Adopt broad branch
options.body: Treat the branch as maintainer-owned broad work and require review/proof for the workflow, mobile, protocol, channel, Codex, docs, generated, and UI surfaces before merge.

options.title: Close and reopen narrow
options.body: Close this branch as unsuitable and ask for a fresh PR containing only the gateway UTF-16 truncation fix.

recommendation.title: Narrow to gateway fix
recommendation.body: Keep only `src/gateway/node-invoke-plugin-policy.ts` and its test changes, then rerun focused gateway validation on the exact head.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current assignee and latest branch contributor, so he is the best available owner for deciding whether the broad surface was intentional.
